Save Report this job We are looking for a UI/UX Designer to help train and improve cutting-edge AI models. You’ll assess and enhance how AI systems understand, generate, and evaluate design work — including interfaces, layouts, visuals, and user experiences. In this role, you’ll use your design expertise to evaluate AI outputs, provide detailed feedback, and help refine the model’s sense of aesthetics, usability, and creative quality. Your insights will directly shape how the next generation of AI tools supports designers. This is a new and growing area for our company — focused on teaching AI to better understand visual and design principles. At this stage, designers should apply through our general core assessment and then complete a qualification for Web & UI/UX Design. Once approved, you’ll not only have access to general AI training projects but also be invited to contribute to design-specific projects. These projects focus on areas such as UI/UX critique, product visuals, and aesthetic evaluation (including presentations and creative deliverables). Benefits This is a full-time or part-time REMOTE position You’ll be able to choose which projects you want to work on You can work on your own schedule General AI training projects start at $25-$30+ USD/hr, while design-focused projects start at $40+ USD/hr, with bonuses for exceptional work. Responsibilities Review and critique AI-generated UI/UX designs, mockups, and visuals Evaluate the quality produced by AI models for correctness and performance Help train models to better understand aesthetic quality and user-centered design Qualifications Fluency in English (native or bilingual level) Background in UI/UX design, web design, product design, or graphic design Strong understanding of visual hierarchy, interaction design, and user flow Excellent command of grammar, style, and brand voice A current, in progress, or completed Bachelor's is preferred but not required Note: Payment is made via PayPal. We will never ask for any money from you. PayPal will handle any currency conversions from USD. Only applicants in the United States will be considered for this role. We are looking for a UI/UX Designer to help train and improve cutting-edge AI models. You’ll assess and enhance how AI systems understand, generate, and evaluate design work — including interfaces, layouts, visuals, and user experiences. In this role, you’ll use your design expertise to evaluate AI outputs, provide detailed feedback, and help refine the model’s sense of aesthetics, usability, and creative quality. Your insights will directly shape how the next generation of AI tools supports designers. This is a new and growing area for our company — focused on teaching AI to better understand visual and design principles. At this stage, designers should apply through our general core assessment and then complete a qualification for Web & UI/UX Design. Once approved, you’ll not only have access to general AI training projects but also be invited to contribute to design-specific projects. These projects focus on areas such as UI/UX critique, product visuals, and aesthetic evaluation (including presentations and creative deliverables). Benefits This is a full-time or part-time REMOTE position You’ll be able to choose which projects you want to work on You can work on your own schedule General AI training projects start at $25-$30+ USD/hr, while design-focused projects start at $40+ USD/hr, with bonuses for exceptional work. Responsibilities Review and critique AI-generated UI/UX designs, mockups, and visuals Evaluate the quality produced by AI models for correctness and performance Help train models to better understand aesthetic quality and user-centered design Qualifications Fluency in English (native or bilingual level) Background in UI/UX design, web design, product design, or graphic design Strong understanding of visual hierarchy, interaction design, and user flow Excellent command of grammar, style, and brand voice A current, in progress, or completed Bachelor's is preferred but not required Note: Payment is made via PayPal. We will never ask for any money from you. PayPal will handle any currency conversions from USD. Only applicants in the United States will be considered for this role. We are looking for a UI/UX Designer to help train and improve cutting-edge AI models. You’ll assess and enhance how AI systems understand, generate, and evaluate design work — including interfaces, layouts, visuals, and user experiences. In this role, you’ll use your design expertise to evaluate AI outputs, provide detailed feedback, and help refine the model’s sense of aesthetics, usability, and creative quality. Your insights will directly shape how the next generation of AI tools supports designers. This is a new and growing area for our company — focused on teaching AI to better understand visual and design principles. At this stage, designers should apply through our general core assessment and then complete a qualification for Web & UI/UX Design. Once approved, you’ll not only have access to general AI training projects but also be invited to contribute to design-specific projects. These projects focus on areas such as UI/UX critique, product visuals, and aesthetic evaluation (including presentations and creative deliverables). Benefits This is a full-time or part-time REMOTE position You’ll be able to choose which projects you want to work on You can work on your own schedule General AI training projects start at $25-$30+ USD/hr, while design-focused projects start at $40+ USD/hr, with bonuses for exceptional work. Responsibilities Review and critique AI-generated UI/UX designs, mockups, and visuals Evaluate the quality produced by AI models for correctness and performance Help train models to better understand aesthetic quality and user-centered design Qualifications Fluency in English (native or bilingual level) Background in UI/UX design, web design, product design, or graphic design Strong understanding of visual hierarchy, interaction design, and user flow Excellent command of grammar, style, and brand voice A current, in progress, or completed Bachelor's is preferred but not required Note: Payment is made via PayPal. We will never ask for any money from you. PayPal will handle any currency conversions from USD. Only applicants in the United States will be considered for this role. We are looking for a UI/UX Designer to help train and improve cutting-edge AI models. You’ll assess and enhance how AI systems understand, generate, and evaluate design work — including interfaces, layouts, visuals, and user experiences. In this role, you’ll use your design expertise to evaluate AI outputs, provide detailed feedback, and help refine the model’s sense of aesthetics, usability, and creative quality. Your insights will directly shape how the next generation of AI tools supports designers. This is a new and growing area for our company — focused on teaching AI to better understand visual and design principles. At this stage, designers should apply through our general core assessment and then complete a qualification for Web & UI/UX Design. Once approved, you’ll not only have access to general AI training projects but also be invited to contribute to design-specific projects. These projects focus on areas such as UI/UX critique, product visuals, and aesthetic evaluation (including presentations and creative deliverables). Benefits This is a full-time or part-time REMOTE position You’ll be able to choose which projects you want to work on You can work on your own schedule General AI training projects start at $25-$30+ USD/hr, while design-focused projects start at $40+ USD/hr, with bonuses for exceptional work. Responsibilities Review and critique AI-generated UI/UX designs, mockups, and visuals Evaluate the quality produced by AI models for correctness and performance Help train models to better understand aesthetic quality and user-centered design Qualifications Fluency in English (native or bilingual level) Background in UI/UX design, web design, product design, or graphic design Strong understanding of visual hierarchy, interaction design, and user flow Excellent command of grammar, style, and brand voice A current, in progress, or completed Bachelor's is preferred but not required Note: Payment is made via PayPal. We will never ask for any money from you. PayPal will handle any currency conversions from USD. Only applicants in the United States will be considered for this role. Job Title: Jr Designer (UI/UX & Mobile Design) Location-Type: Remote (EST Hours) Start Date Is: ASAP Duration: 12 month contract with opportunity to convert Compensation Range: $40-$49.50/hr W2 Benefits: Eligible for Health, Dental, Vision, 401K Must be authorized to work in the U.S. This position is not eligible for sponsorship. Job Description: The client is seeking a Jr Designer to support the ongoing evolution of the rec.gov web and mobile experience within a large-scale enterprise environment. This individual will work across multiple product streams and microservice teams to help improve UI consistency, scalability, accessibility, and overall user experience across web and mobile platforms. The role is heavily focused on Figma design systems, reusable component architecture, and mobile-first product design within a collaborative Agile environment. Day-to-Day Responsibilities: Design intuitive user experiences across web and mobile applications (iOS & Android) Create wireframes, mockups, prototypes, and high-fidelity UI designs in Figma Work within and expand large-scale Figma component libraries and design systems Maintain consistency across products, pages, and application experiences Partner closely with product owners, developers, and cross-functional teams during Agile sprint cycles Take notes, requirements, and wireframes from meetings and independently execute design solutions Support repository cleanup, design audits, and scalable UI organization efforts Balance work across multiple microservice and vertical product teams simultaneously Participate in design reviews, critiques, and iterative feedback cycles Contribute to responsive, accessible, and mobile-first design initiatives Minimum Requirements: 2+ years of experience in UI/UX, product design, or digital design environments Strong experience with Figma, including component libraries, auto-layout, and scalable design systems Experience creating and maintaining reusable UI components across enterprise applications Experience designing for mobile applications (iOS and Android) Strong understanding of responsive design, typography, layout, usability, and accessibility principles Experience collaborating within Agile/Scrum product environments Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and execute with minimal oversight Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate across multiple teams and stakeholders Experience taking wireframes or product requirements and translating them into polished UI solutions Experience using Adobe Photoshop and Adobe Illustrator Preferred Qualifications: Experience supporting high-traffic or enterprise-scale eCommerce platforms Experience working within large application ecosystems or microservice-driven product teams Familiarity with React component-based frameworks and design-to-development handoff processes Experience with design system governance and scalable UI architecture Understanding of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript fundamentals Experience with motion design or We are looking for a UI/UX Designer to help train and improve cutting-edge AI models. You’ll assess and enhance how AI systems understand, generate, and evaluate design work — including interfaces, layouts, visuals, and user experiences. In this role, you’ll use your design expertise to evaluate AI outputs, provide detailed feedback, and help refine the model’s sense of aesthetics, usability, and creative quality. Your insights will directly shape how the next generation of AI tools supports designers. This is a new and growing area for our company — focused on teaching AI to better understand visual and design principles. At this stage, designers should apply through our general core assessment and then complete a qualification for Web & UI/UX Design. Once approved, you’ll not only have access to general AI training projects but also be invited to contribute to design-specific projects. These projects focus on areas such as UI/UX critique, product visuals, and aesthetic evaluation (including presentations and creative deliverables). Benefits This is a full-time or part-time REMOTE position You’ll be able to choose which projects you want to work on You can work on your own schedule General AI training projects start at $25-$30+ USD/hr, while design-focused projects start at $40+ USD/hr, with bonuses for exceptional work. Responsibilities Review and critique AI-generated UI/UX designs, mockups, and visuals Evaluate the quality produced by AI models for correctness and performance Help train models to better understand aesthetic quality and user-centered design Qualifications Fluency in English (native or bilingual level) Background in UI/UX design, web design, product design, or graphic design Strong understanding of visual hierarchy, interaction design, and user flow Excellent command of grammar, style, and brand voice A current, in progress, or completed Bachelor's is preferred but not required Note: Payment is made via PayPal. We will never ask for any money from you. PayPal will handle any currency conversions from USD. Only applicants in the United States will be considered for this role. We are looking for a UI/UX Designer to help train and improve cutting-edge AI models. You’ll assess and enhance how AI systems understand, generate, and evaluate design work — including interfaces, layouts, visuals, and user experiences. In this role, you’ll use your design expertise to evaluate AI outputs, provide detailed feedback, and help refine the model’s sense of aesthetics, usability, and creative quality. Your insights will directly shape how the next generation of AI tools supports designers. This is a new and growing area for our company — focused on teaching AI to better understand visual and design principles. At this stage, designers should apply through our general core assessment and then complete a qualification for Web & UI/UX Design. Once approved, you’ll not only have access to general AI training projects but also be invited to contribute to design-specific projects. These projects focus on areas such as UI/UX critique, product visuals, and aesthetic evaluation (including presentations and creative deliverables). Benefits This is a full-time or part-time REMOTE position You’ll be able to choose which projects you want to work on You can work on your own schedule General AI training projects start at $25-$30+ USD/hr, while design-focused projects start at $40+ USD/hr, with bonuses for exceptional work. Responsibilities Review and critique AI-generated UI/UX designs, mockups, and visuals Evaluate the quality produced by AI models for correctness and performance Help train models to better understand aesthetic quality and user-centered design Qualifications Fluency in English (native or bilingual level) Background in UI/UX design, web design, product design, or graphic design Strong understanding of visual hierarchy, interaction design, and user flow Excellent command of grammar, style, and brand voice A current, in progress, or completed Bachelor's is preferred but not required Note: Payment is made via PayPal. We will never ask for any money from you. PayPal will handle any currency conversions from USD. Only applicants in the United States will be considered for this role. Export Control/ITAR: Certain roles may be subject to U.S. export control laws, requiring U.S. person status as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3). Please review the job details below. This position requires an active U.S. Government Security Clearance at the TS/SCI level with required polygraph. We are seeking an experienced UI/UX Designer to lead human-centered design efforts for mission-critical applications supporting government users. This role is responsible for end-to-end UX and UI design, from user research and analysis through interaction design, prototyping, and delivery. The ideal candidate brings a strong balance of research-driven UX practice and high-quality visual/UI design and is comfortable operating within the constraints of government environments. This role works closely with product managers, engineers, and stakeholders to ensure designs are grounded in real user needs, validated through research, and translated into intuitive, accessible interfaces. Responsibilities User Research & Analysis Plan and conduct user research activities including interviews, usability testing, and feedback sessions with diverse user groups (e.g., analysts, SMEs, managers, data scientists). Analyze and synthesize research findings into actionable insights, personas, user journeys, and workflow maps. Document research findings and recommendations to support stakeholder understanding and buy-in, particularly in government settings. Apply ethical, secure, and compliant research practices appropriate for classified or sensitive environments. UX Strategy & Design Systems Lead UX and UI efforts for complex, high-visibility applications. Define, maintain, and evolve design systems and component libraries in collaboration with engineering teams. Establish consistent interaction patterns, workflows, and design standards across multiple applications. Create service blueprints and end-to-end experience maps to align cross-functional teams. UI Design & Prototyping Develop interactive prototypes using tools such as Figma, Adobe XD, or similar, to explore concepts and validate user flows. Produce high-fidelity UI designs that are accessible, usable, and visually consistent. Ensure designs align with accessibility standards (e.g., WCAG) and applicable government design guidelines. Document interaction behaviors, design rationale, and micro-copy to support implementation. Minimum Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Design, Human-Computer Interaction, Psychology, Computer Science, or a related field (or equivalent experience). Minimum of 5 years of professional experience in UI/UX design. Demonstrated experience conducting UX research, analysis, and synthesis (not UI-only). Strong proficiency with design and prototyping tools such as Figma, Adobe XD, or equivalent. Experience collaborating closely with product managers and engineering teams. Ability to clearly articulate design decisions and research findings to stakeholders. Willingness to work onsite full time in McLean, VA. Preferred Qualifications Portfolio (website, case studies, or work samples) demonstrating UX research methodology, analysis, and UI design quality. Experience designing for mission-critical or government systems. Familiarity with accessibility standards (WCAG) and inclusive design practices. Experience contributing to or managing design systems. Familiarity with modern front-end frameworks and design constraints (e.g., component-based development). Experience supporting data-heavy or analytical user workflows. Save Report this job We are looking for a UI/UX Designer to help train and improve cutting-edge AI models. You’ll assess and enhance how AI systems understand, generate, and evaluate design work — including interfaces, layouts, visuals, and user experiences. In this role, you’ll use your design expertise to evaluate AI outputs, provide detailed feedback, and help refine the model’s sense of aesthetics, usability, and creative quality. Your insights will directly shape how the next generation of AI tools supports designers. This is a new and growing area for our company — focused on teaching AI to better understand visual and design principles. At this stage, designers should apply through our general core assessment and then complete a qualification for Web & UI/UX Design. Subject to your and their settings , when you connect with other Members, you will be able to search each others’ connections in order to exchange professional opportunities. We also use the data we have about you to suggest skills you could add to your profile and skills that you might need to pursue your next opportunity. We may use automated systems to provide content and recommendations to help make our Services more relevant to our Members, Visitors and customers. Keeping your profile accurate and up-to-date may help you better connect to others and to opportunities through our Services. Productivity Our Services allow you to collaborate with colleagues, search for potential clients, customers, partners and others to do business with. Our Services allow you to communicate with other Members and schedule and prepare meetings with them. We are looking for a UI/UX Designer to help train and improve cutting-edge AI models. You’ll assess and enhance how AI systems understand, generate, and evaluate design work — including interfaces, layouts, visuals, and user experiences. In this role, you’ll use your design expertise to evaluate AI outputs, provide detailed feedback, and help refine the model’s sense of aesthetics, usability, and creative quality. Your insights will directly shape how the next generation of AI tools supports designers. This is a new and growing area for our company — focused on teaching AI to better understand visual and design principles. At this stage, designers should apply through our general core assessment and then complete a qualification for Web & UI/UX Design. Once approved, you’ll not only have access to general AI training projects but also be invited to contribute to design-specific projects. These projects focus on areas such as UI/UX critique, product visuals, and aesthetic evaluation (including presentations and creative deliverables). Benefits This is a full-time or part-time REMOTE position You’ll be able to choose which projects you want to work on You can work on your own schedule General AI training projects start at $25-$30+ USD/hr, while design-focused projects start at $40+ USD/hr, with bonuses for exceptional work. Responsibilities Review and critique AI-generated UI/UX designs, mockups, and visuals Evaluate the quality produced by AI models for correctness and performance Help train models to better understand aesthetic quality and user-centered design Qualifications Fluency in English (native or bilingual level) Background in UI/UX design, web design, product design, or graphic design Strong understanding of visual hierarchy, interaction design, and user flow Excellent command of grammar, style, and brand voice A current, in progress, or completed Bachelor's is preferred but not required Note: Payment is made via PayPal. This Cookie Policy applies to any LinkedIn product or service that links to this policy or incorporates it by reference. We use cookies and similar technologies such as pixels, local storage and mobile ad IDs (collectively referred to in this policy as “cookies”) to collect and use data as part of our Services, as defined in our Privacy Policy (“Services”) and which includes our sites, communications, mobile applications and off-site Services, such as our ad services and the “Apply with LinkedIn” and “Share with LinkedIn” plugins or tags. ENTER A SUMMARY Type of technology Description Cookies A cookie is a small file placed onto your device that enables LinkedIn features and functionality. Any browser visiting our sites may receive cookies from us or cookies from third parties such as our customers, partners or service providers. We or third parties may also place cookies in your browser when you visit non-LinkedIn sites that display ads or that host our plugins or tags . We use two types of cookies: persistent cookies and session cookies. A persistent cookie lasts beyond the current session and is used for many purposes, such as recognizing you as an existing user, so it’s easier to return to LinkedIn and interact with our Services without signing in again. Since a persistent cookie stays in your browser, it will be read by LinkedIn when you return to one of our sites or visit a third party site that uses our Services. Session cookies last only as long as the session (usually the current visit to a website or a browser session). Pixels A pixel is a tiny image that may be embedded within web pages and emails, requiring a call (which provides device and visit information) to our servers in order for the pixel to be rendered in those web pages and emails. We use pixels to learn more about your interactions with email content or web content, such as whether you interacted with ads or posts. Pixels can also enable us and third parties to place cookies on your browser. Local storage Local storage enables a website or application to store information locally on your device(s). Local storage may be used to improve the LinkedIn experience, for example, by enabling features, remembering your preferences and speeding up site functionality. Other similar technologies We also use other tracking technologies, such as mobile advertising IDs and tags for similar purposes as described in this Cookie Policy. References to similar technologies in this policy includes pixels, local storage, and other tracking technologies. ENTER SUMMARY Purpose Description Authentication We use cookies and similar technologies to recognize you when you visit our Services. Customized content We use cookies and similar technologies to customize your experience on our Services. For example, we may use cookies to remember previous searches so that when you return to our services, we can offer additional information that relates to your previous search. Plugins on and off LinkedIn We use cookies and similar technologies to enable LinkedIn plugins both on and off the LinkedIn sites. If you are a LinkedIn member but logged out of your account on a browser, LinkedIn may still continue to log your interaction with our Services on that browser until the expiration of the cookie in order to generate usage analytics for our Services. We are looking for a UI/UX Designer to help train and improve cutting-edge AI models. You’ll assess and enhance how AI systems understand, generate, and evaluate design work — including interfaces, layouts, visuals, and user experiences. In this role, you’ll use your design expertise to evaluate AI outputs, provide detailed feedback, and help refine the model’s sense of aesthetics, usability, and creative quality. Your insights will directly shape how the next generation of AI tools supports designers. This is a new and growing area for our company — focused on teaching AI to better understand visual and design principles. At this stage, designers should apply through our general core assessment and then complete a qualification for Web & UI/UX Design. Once approved, you’ll not only have access to general AI training projects but also be invited to contribute to design-specific projects. These projects focus on areas such as UI/UX critique, product visuals, and aesthetic evaluation (including presentations and creative deliverables). Benefits This is a full-time or part-time REMOTE position You’ll be able to choose which projects you want to work on You can work on your own schedule General AI training projects start at $25-$30+ USD/hr, while design-focused projects start at $40+ USD/hr, with bonuses for exceptional work. Responsibilities Review and critique AI-generated UI/UX designs, mockups, and visuals Evaluate the quality produced by AI models for correctness and performance Help train models to better understand aesthetic quality and user-centered design Qualifications Fluency in English (native or bilingual level) Background in UI/UX design, web design, product design, or graphic design Strong understanding of visual hierarchy, interaction design, and user flow Excellent command of grammar, style, and brand voice A current, in progress, or completed Bachelor's is preferred but not required Note: Payment is made via PayPal. We will never ask for any money from you. PayPal will handle any currency conversions from USD. Only applicants in the United States will be considered for this role. If you've seen this acronym floating around your feed lately and thought "I should probably know what that is," you're not alone. Let's break it down. ✨ MCP stands for Model Context Protocol. It's an open standard created by Anthropic (the company behind Claude) that gives your AI tools a common language to speak with the rest of your tech stack. Here's the problem it solves. Right now, many AI tools operate in a silo. Your AI assistant can chat with you out of the box, but it can't pull a report from your CRM, check your ad performance, or look at your analytics unless someone builds a custom connection for each one. And every new tool means another custom integration. That's complex. 😵 MCP simplifies that by creating one standard way for AI tools to connect to your company's tech stack. Instead of building a unique integration for every combination of AI tool and data source, you have one connection that works across the board. Think of it like hiring a translator who speaks every language in the room. Instead of needing a separate translator for every conversation, one person handles it all. That's basically what MCP does for AI. So what does this look like in practice? Say you're a marketer (which you probably are if you're reading this post 😉). With MCP, your AI assistant could pull your latest campaign data from Google Ads, cross-reference it with lead data in a CRM, and draft a performance summary, all without you toggling between five different tabs. MCP adoption has been fast, too. OpenAI, Google, and Microsoft have all gotten behind MCP, and major CRM players like Salesforce and Nutshell are building with it. 📣 The big question: Why should you care right now? Because the companies that (safely and securely) connect their AI tools to their actual business data are going to move a lot faster than the ones still copy-pasting between platforms. You don't need to become an MCP expert overnight. But understanding what it is and where it's headed puts you ahead. 3 Like Comment Share WebFX 88,246 followers 2d Report this post The wait is over — ChatGPT has officially launched its self-serve ad portal, meaning businesses can now have ads appear in front of the leading AI tool's audience. AI models need to be able to interpret your content before they cite it. That's the role structured data plays. Schema markup is a type of structured data that helps AI systems understand what your content is about and who's behind it, translating it into a format machines can interpret. 𝗪𝗵𝘆 𝗶𝘁 𝗺𝗮𝘁𝘁𝗲𝗿𝘀 When AI models can interpret your content accurately, the results can be significant. Your brand doesn't just show up in a list of results. It becomes part of the AI answer. That gives you visibility directly inside the user's AI interaction, which tells users and algorithms your content is trustworthy. You get qualified traffic when users click to learn more and long-term brand credibility from consistently appearing in authoritative AI outputs. 𝗪𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝘁𝗼 𝗱𝗼 There are several schema types you can add to your website to improve your AI performance: 👉 Article, NewsArticle, and BlogPosting — for establishing content type, authorship, and E-E-A-T credibility. 👉 FAQ and HowTo — for surfacing clear answers and step-by-step instructions in AI responses. 👉 Product, Offer, and Review — for appearing in shopping-related AI results and product comparisons. 👉 Organization and LocalBusiness — for improving brand accuracy and mention consistency across AI platforms. 👉 Person and Author — for connecting expertise and identity to your content, helping AI cite thought leaders. 👉 Dataset and ResearchStudy — for content that references original

helping AI cite thought leaders. 👉 Dataset and ResearchStudy — for content that references original data, benchmarks, or statistics. Once you have your schema types chosen, you need to ensure that it's implemented in an accurate, complete, and consistent way. Schema.org offers a tool to help you validate the schema on your website, so that's a great place to look when you're in the quality control phase. In addition, align your schema type with the intent of each page and pair your markup with clear headings, descriptive metadata, and internal links that reinforce meaning for AI models. 𝗪𝗵𝗲𝗿𝗲 𝗶𝘁'𝘀 𝗵𝗲𝗮𝗱𝗶𝗻𝗴 Structured data is only going to get more important and more integrated into the platforms and tools you use every day. If your content isn't structured, it's invisible to the systems shaping the next era of search. The brands that treat structured data as an AI visibility strategy, and not just a technical SEO checkbox, are the ones that will lead in this new landscape. We are looking for a UI/UX Designer to help train and improve cutting-edge AI models. You’ll assess and enhance how AI systems understand, generate, and evaluate design work — including interfaces, layouts, visuals, and user experiences. In this role, you’ll use your design expertise to evaluate AI outputs, provide detailed feedback, and help refine the model’s sense of aesthetics, usability, and creative quality. Your insights will directly shape how the next generation of AI tools supports designers. This is a new and growing area for our company — focused on teaching AI to better understand visual and design principles. At this stage, designers should apply through our general core assessment and then complete a qualification for Web & UI/UX Design. Once approved, you’ll not only have access to general AI training projects but also be invited to contribute to design-specific projects. These projects focus on areas such as UI/UX critique, product visuals, and aesthetic evaluation (including presentations and creative deliverables). Benefits This is a full-time or part-time REMOTE position You’ll be able to choose which projects you want to work on You can work on your own schedule General AI training projects start at $25-$30+ USD/hr, while design-focused projects start at $40+ USD/hr, with bonuses for exceptional work. Responsibilities Review and critique AI-generated UI/UX designs, mockups, and visuals Evaluate the quality produced by AI models for correctness and performance Help train models to better understand aesthetic quality and user-centered design Qualifications Fluency in English (native or bilingual level) Background in UI/UX design, web design, product design, or graphic design Strong understanding of visual hierarchy, interaction design, and user flow Excellent command of grammar, style, and brand voice A current, in progress, or completed Bachelor's is preferred but not required Note: Payment is made via PayPal. We will never ask for any money from you. PayPal will handle any currency conversions from USD. Only applicants in the United States will be considered for this role. Save Report this job Title: UI/UX Developer Location: Onsite in San Antonio, TX Rate: $40/hr C2C Duration: 1 year Start Date: June 10 Engagement Summary UI/UX Developer to drive and advance next-generation digital workplace UI/UX initiatives. The developer will be the lead resource for translating business needs into holistic mobile and web experiences, serving as a designer-developer hybrid across several visible projects. Key Responsibilities Research, design, develop, test, and integrate UX designs into JavaScript/Java codebases — owning technical feasibility end-to-end. Act as designer-developer / SME on high-visibility projects, switching between design and development as needed. Produce clean, semantic HTML markup that meets WCAG and ADA/Section 508 standards. Build and support a customer-facing design system — components, defects, accessibility, and page templates. Develop responsive, reusable interactive patterns and code libraries meeting W3 standards for HTML, JavaScript, and CSS. Hands-on front-end framework development (Vue.js, AngularJS, ReactJS, jQuery). Collaborate with business analysts, senior developers, and architects through SDLC. Maintain design files, wireframes, and mock-ups; drive usability reviews and prototype validation. Stay current on UI/UX trends and recommend new tools and methods. Minimum Qualifications Extensive ADA / WCAG accessibility experience Deep, hands-on front-end web application development experience. Experience in creating conceptual and detailed design solutions grounded in end-user needs. Working knowledge of storyboarding tools (Adobe Creative Suite, Sketch, InVision). Track record working with cross-functional teams in Agile/Scrum. Strong skills in end-to-end Human-Centered Design (HCD) design, research, usability. Comfort communicating with business and technology stakeholders to deliver holistic solutions. Preferred Qualifications UI/UX or web developer certifications and training. Prior experience in the Electric and Gas Utility industry. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related business/technical field (or equivalent experience). Exposure to Vue.js, AngularJS, ReactJS, jQuery. Familiarity with screen reader tools (VoiceOver, JAWS, NVDA). Experience inside Agile ceremonies and methodologies. Adobe AEM exposure (nice-to-have per client). We are looking for a UI/UX Designer to help train and improve cutting-edge AI models. You’ll assess and enhance how AI systems understand, generate, and evaluate design work — including interfaces, layouts, visuals, and user experiences. In this role, you’ll use your design expertise to evaluate AI outputs, provide detailed feedback, and help refine the model’s sense of aesthetics, usability, and creative quality. Your insights will directly shape how the next generation of AI tools supports designers. This is a new and growing area for our company — focused on teaching AI to better understand visual and design principles. At this stage, designers should apply through our general core assessment and then complete a qualification for Web & UI/UX Design. Once approved, you’ll not only have access to general AI training projects but also be invited to contribute to design-specific projects. These projects focus on areas such as UI/UX critique, product visuals, and aesthetic evaluation (including presentations and creative deliverables). Benefits This is a full-time or part-time REMOTE position You’ll be able to choose which projects you want to work on You can work on your own schedule General AI training projects start at $25-$30+ USD/hr, while design-focused projects start at $40+ USD/hr, with bonuses for exceptional work. Responsibilities Review and critique AI-generated UI/UX designs, mockups, and visuals Evaluate the quality produced by AI models for correctness and performance Help train models to better understand aesthetic quality and user-centered design Qualifications Fluency in English (native or bilingual level) Background in UI/UX design, web design, product design, or graphic design Strong understanding of visual hierarchy, interaction design, and user flow Excellent command of grammar, style, and brand voice A current, in progress, or completed Bachelor's is preferred but not required Note: Payment is made via PayPal. We will never ask for any money from you. PayPal will handle any currency conversions from USD. Only applicants in the United States will be considered for this role. Roku is changing how the world watches TV Roku is the #1 TV streaming platform in the U.S., Canada, and Mexico, and we've set our sights on powering every television in the world. Roku pioneered streaming to the TV. Our mission is to be the TV streaming platform that connects the entire TV ecosystem. We connect consumers to the content they love, enable content publishers to build and monetize large audiences, and provide advertisers unique capabilities to engage consumers. From your first day at Roku, you'll make a valuable - and valued - contribution. We're a fast-growing public company where no one is a bystander. We offer you the opportunity to delight millions of TV streamers around the world while gaining meaningful experience across a variety of disciplines. About the Team We believe that great user experiences come from people who have the vision to see the big picture while still maintaining an incredible attention to detail. The User Experience team at Roku is comprised of UX designers, researchers, and writers working collaboratively with our world-class Product and Engineering teams to meet customer needs for a Roku experience that delivers simplicity and delight. About the Role Roku is looking for a UX Product Designer with strong interaction design skills to drive improvements to our Premium Subscription services within The Roku Channel, with an initial focus on migrating our standalone Frndly TV live TV streaming service into our Premium Subscriptions experiences. This design work will involve UX for browsing and searching for shows, live TV guide integration, merchandising, subscription flows, playback, and more, with a strong focus on collaboration with other UX designers working in these areas. The Roku Channel currently offers more than 50 premium subscription services – including Paramount+, HBO Max, and Discovery+ -- with more coming every quarter. Each features a consistent user interface to help customers enjoy their entertainment across multiple subscriptions in one place. For California Only - The estimated annual salary for this position is between $185,000 and $210,000 annually. Compensation packages are based on factors unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, certifications, and specific geographical location. This role is eligible for health insurance, equity awards, life insurance, disability benefits, parental leave, wellness benefits, and paid time off. What You’ll be Doing Work closely with product managers and business stakeholders to identify the problems, business goals, and user outcomes that your designs will address Design features for Premium Subscription services within The Roku Channel, with an initial focus on our Frndly live TV streaming platform, so that they collectively create a consistent, seamless, easy-to-use experience for customers to subscribe to and watch their favorite shows Collaborate closely with Product Management and developers throughout the project lifecycle Partner with experienced User Researchers to gain insight on user needs, and to determine and execute the ideal research methodology to evaluate your designs Collaborate with other UX designers responsible for features related to browsing, searching, playback, live TV Guide, sign-up flows, and more Own your designs and communicate effectively, articulating your design decisions to colleagues from diverse disciplines Give and receive feedback in regular design critiques with your peers and during formal design reviews with UX management We’re Excited If You Have Experience designing a variety of features related to TV streaming services for consumer audiences A proven track record in interaction design, showing artifacts of the process that help support your design decisions, as well as the business results driven by those designs Experience collaborating with product managers, developers, and management to refine design concepts through rapid iterations, meeting the goals of both users and the business Hands-on experience working with User Researchers (or conducting User Research yourself) and utilizing the results of that research to shape your designs Expertise in designing and prototyping with Figma A passion for getting the subtle details right when it comes to creating a high-performing, world-class experience Endless empathy for the user A degree in Design, Computer Science, Human-Computer Interaction, or a related field Our Hybrid Work Approach Roku fosters an inclusive and collaborative environment where teams work in the office Monday through Thursday. Fridays are flexible for remote work except for employees whose roles are required to be in the office five days a week or employees who are in offices with a five day in office policy. Benefits Roku is committed to offering a diverse range of benefits as part of our compensation package to support our employees and their families. Our comprehensive benefits include global access to mental health and financial wellness support and resources. Local benefits include statutory and voluntary benefits which may include healthcare (medical, dental, and vision), life, accident, disability, commuter, and retirement options (401(k)/pension). Our employees can take time off work for vacation and other personal reasons to balance their evolving work and life needs. It's important to note that not every benefit is available in all locations or for every role. For details specific to your location, please consult with your recruiter. Accommodations Roku welcomes applicants of all backgrounds and provides reasonable accommodations and adjustments in accordance with applicable law. If you require reasonable accommodation at any point in the hiring process, please direct your inquiries to EmployeeRelations@Roku.com. The Roku Culture Roku is a great place for people who want to work in a fast-paced environment where everyone is focused on the company's success rather than their own. We try to surround ourselves with people who are great at their jobs, who are easy to work with, and who keep their egos in check. We appreciate a sense of humor. We believe a fewer number of very talented folks can do more for less cost than a larger number of less talented teams. We're independent thinkers with big ideas who act boldly, move fast and accomplish extraordinary things through collaboration and trust. In short, at Roku you'll be part of a company that's changing how the world watches TV. We have a unique culture that we are proud of. We think of ourselves primarily as problem-solvers, which itself is a two-part idea. We come up with the solution, but the solution isn't real until it is built and delivered to the customer. That penchant for action gives us a pragmatic approach to innovation, one that has served us well since 2002. To learn more about Roku, our global footprint, and how we've grown, visit https://www.weareroku.com/factsheet. It is where thousands of communities come together for whatever, every day. We’re about community, inside and out. You’ll find coworkers who are eager to team up, collaborate, and smash (or elegantly solve) problems together. We’re on a quest to empower live communities, so if this sounds good to you, see what we’re up to on LinkedIn and X, and discover the projects we’re solving on our Blog. About The Team The Twitch Monetization UX team is responsible for designing the experiences that power sustainable growth for creators, viewers, and Twitch itself. We build and evolve the systems that enable creators to earn while ensuring that revenue opportunities feel natural, rewarding, and aligned with the spirit of live communities. A Monetization UX Designer is expected to lead design work at the project level, partner closely with senior cross-functional stakeholders, represent work to executive leadership, and guide and mentor junior designers while reporting directly to a Director of Design. About The Role Designers on the Monetization team work across the full product lifecycle—from early concept and opportunity exploration through launch and ongoing iteration. You will collaborate closely with product managers, engineers, and data partners to design thoughtful monetization experiences that balance business goals with creator and viewer trust. Success in this role requires strong systems thinking, experimentation mindset, and a deep care for the people who power Twitch’s communities. If you are passionate about designing revenue experiences that empower creators, strengthen communities, and feel intuitive and fair for users, you will thrive on this team. You can work from Twitch’s headquarters in San Francisco, CA; or from one of our hub locations in Seattle, WA; Irvine, CA; or New York City, NY You Will: Collaborate with a cross functional development team of product managers, engineers, designers, and more. Learn from streamers, viewers, and businesses about the ways they use our services and their desires to accomplish more Think creatively about how to solve problems that will sustain streamers’ monetization journey on Twitch Contribute to the design community at Twitch by using and improving existing patterns and approaches Combine qualitative and quantitative information to develop hypotheses about customer motivations and use that to improve your designs Present your work to others by participating in design reviews and feedback sessions You Have: 3+ years of practical experience in UX design with an emphasis on content discovery and/or content engagement experiences. Demonstrated interaction design and visual craft skills including experience with prototyping mobile experiences. Demonstrated skills collaborating closely with other designers, researchers, product managers and engineers. An aesthetic sense and the ability to make confident decisions. Demonstrated empathy for the people using your software or products. Expertise with Figma. Experience in E-Commerce/Monetization. Bonus Points Experience working on consumer software products Experience with AI tooling Experience executing research plans by talking to real customers Knowledge of design systems Formal education in Design, Interaction/UX Design or HCI Perks Medical, Dental, Vision & Disability Insurance 401(k) Maternity & Parental Leave Flexible PTO Amazon Employee Discount Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. How You’ll LEAD We’re looking for a UI/UX Designer to design and optimize direct-to-consumer (D2C) online stores for some of the world’s leading artists and labels. You’ll help shape the way fans experience, interact and purchase from their favorite artists through beautifully crafted, high-performing e-commerce experiences. You’ll be responsible for elevating the artists’ worlds, thinking like a superfan but with razor sharp digital design skills — translating music culture, brand identity, and merchandising into seamless, emotionally engaging online stores that drive sales and fan loyalty. You’ll work closely with the wider design/motion teams to build out the ultimate fan experience and collaborate with store front developers and back end systems teams to push our sites and stores into better experience for our artist and consumers. How You’ll CREATE Design and iterate on e-commerce experiences — from landing pages and prouct detail pages to checkout and campaign microsites — that bring artist brands to life. Be able to present your ideas clearly and advocate for good interface and experience. Create user flows, wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity designs that balance storytelling, usability, and conversion. Collaborate with developers, merchandisers, and marketing teams to ensure pixel-perfect implementation and an exceptional end-to-end customer journey. Use insights from analytics, A/B testing, and fan feedback to refine and optimize store performance. Translate brand and album aesthetics into cohesive digital experiences aligned with campaign visuals and creative direction. Advocate for best-in-class UX practices, accessibility, and responsive design across all digital touchpoints. Work closely with developers to ensure the feasibility and implementation of design solutions. Bring Your VIBE 3+ years of experience in UI/UX design, ideally in e-commerce, entertainment, or consumer brands. Strong portfolio demonstrating responsive design, visual design systems, and UX problem-solving. Excellent proficiency in Figma/prototyping tools and Adobe Creative Suite Good working knowledge of Shopify and/or other D2C e-commerce platforms Understanding of digital merchandising, conversion optimization, and checkout flow best practices. Comfortable working in a fast-paced, campaign-driven environment with shifting priorities. Nice to have: Experience designing for music artists, record labels, or fan-focused digital products. Familiarity with HTML5, JS, CSS. Passion for music, culture, and innovation. About Zoic Labs Zoic Labs is an advanced visualization company focused on the intersection of data, narrative, design, and emerging technologies. Since 2002, we have developed software and virtual production tools for sister company Zoic Studios, a multi-platform storytelling company with emphasis on high-end computer graphics for film, television, gaming, and VR/AR experiences. We build proprietary products and platforms, and provide UI/UX design, agile software development, R&D, and consulting services for a diverse range of private companies, as well as the U.S. Department of Defense and Intelligence Community. Why Join Zoic Labs? We are an owner-operated technology company, with a focus on providing an excellent experience for our users, clients, and employees We love what we do and always stay curious about new technology and techniques. We respect work/life balance in a hectic industry. We work with a team from all walks of life and backgrounds. Position Description As Zoic Labs’ UI/UX Designer you will be responsible for the visual development and design of applications across platforms such as web, desktop, AR, VR and app design. This is a highly creative position driving the creation of initial concepts and designs for future user interfaces and graphics. You will also work with the engineering department and client/user to find the perfect combination between functional user experience and design. This is a project-based position with an expected start date of June 2026 (6 month project) Responsibilities: Design and champion engaging user interfaces for a variety of clients, ensuring our users have the best possible experience on our platforms Work in collaboration with leadership, product managers, engineers, and other designers Strong sensibility in taking conceptual wireframes to a high fidelity, intuitive final comp Develop high quality UI/UX designs, prototypes and design assets that effectively communicate design concepts Conduct user research and usability testing to identify and address pain points and improve experience for users Skills and Software: Be passionate and knowledgeable about UI and UX design and able to articulate this Solid understanding of visual hierarchy, layout design, and usability design Adobe XD, Illustrator, and Photoshop Zeplin Google Slides Nice to have, but not required: After Effects Figma Agency experience Marketing experience Other Requirements: Updated portfolio that demonstrates UI/UX skills in digital products Self-motivated with the ability to work independently and in collaboration with a team Knowledge of information architecture Experience using Jira Additional Info: Remote work accepted within the U.S., company based in Los Angeles Zoic does not cover relocation costs This job description contains the basic requirements for the position and is NOT intended to be a complete list of responsibilities; other duties may be assigned Pay Range: 40/hr – 50/hr DOE(The actual base salary offered will depend on a variety of factors, including without limitation, the qualifications of the individual applicant for the position, years of relevant experience, level of education attained, certifications or other professional licenses held, and if applicable, the location of the position) Due to the volume of applications we receive across our different openings we regret that only those selected to interview will be contacted Security Clearance: While A current DoD clearance is not required to be eligible for this position, you may be required to obtain a DoD clearance or government customer access within a reasonable time after the offer is extended and must be able to maintain the applicable clearance. We are looking for a UI/UX Designer to help train and improve cutting-edge AI models. You’ll assess and enhance how AI systems understand, generate, and evaluate design work — including interfaces, layouts, visuals, and user experiences. In this role, you’ll use your design expertise to evaluate AI outputs, provide detailed feedback, and help refine the model’s sense of aesthetics, usability, and creative quality. Your insights will directly shape how the next generation of AI tools supports designers. This is a new and growing area for our company — focused on teaching AI to better understand visual and design principles. At this stage, designers should apply through our general core assessment and then complete a qualification for Web & UI/UX Design. Once approved, you’ll not only have access to general AI training projects but also be invited to contribute to design-specific projects. These projects focus on areas such as UI/UX critique, product visuals, and aesthetic evaluation (including presentations and creative deliverables). Benefits This is a full-time or part-time REMOTE position You’ll be able to choose which projects you want to work on You can work on your own schedule General AI training projects start at $25-$30+ USD/hr, while design-focused projects start at $40+ USD/hr, with bonuses for exceptional work. Responsibilities Review and critique AI-generated UI/UX designs, mockups, and visuals Evaluate the quality produced by AI models for correctness and performance Help train models to better understand aesthetic quality and user-centered design Qualifications Fluency in English (native or bilingual level) Background in UI/UX design, web design, product design, or graphic design Strong understanding of visual hierarchy, interaction design, and user flow Excellent command of grammar, style, and brand voice A current, in progress, or completed Bachelor's is preferred but not required Note: Payment is made via PayPal. We will never ask for any money from you. PayPal will handle any currency conversions from USD. Only applicants in the United States will be considered for this role. Overview GovCIO is seeking a UI/UX Designer (Web Developer II) to support the Veterans Readiness & Employment (VRE) Program Support and Enterprise Services (PSES) product line. This remote-only role contributes to the full UX lifecycle, including research, wireframing, prototyping, usability testing, design system usage, and close collaboration with engineering teams. The ideal candidate excels at transforming complex requirements into intuitive workflows and ensuring all design work meets Section 508 accessibility standards. This position is fully remote within the United States. Responsibilities UI/UX Design & Prototyping Design wireframes, mockups, and high-fidelity prototypes using Figma. Build components aligned with the VA.gov design system and Storybook libraries. Support frontend development teams implementing React-based UI features. Translate requirements and user needs into intuitive, scalable interface patterns. User Research & Usability Testing Conduct Veteran-centered user research sessions and usability tests. Identify workflow friction and opportunities for improvement using behavioral insights. Document research findings to guide design decisions and backlog prioritization. Validate concepts through iterative testing cycles with diverse user groups. Design Systems, Accessibility & Documentation Ensure all UI designs are compliant with WCAG/508 accessibility standards. Maintain and contribute to design system documentation and governance. Produce clear UX artifacts including annotated wireframes, workflow diagrams, and specifications. Ensure consistency, clarity, and version control across design deliverables. AI-Enabled Design Support Use AI-enabled tools to support workflow analysis, research synthesis, and pattern detection when appropriate. Validate AI-generated recommendations through user testing, accessibility review, and SME feedback. Promote responsible use of AI to enhance project velocity without compromising clarity, accessibility, or trust. Cross-Functional Collaboration & Agile Delivery Collaborate with product owners, developers, researchers, and SMEs to align design intent. Participate in Agile ceremonies, planning sessions, and design reviews. Clearly articulate design rationale, user needs, and constraints to technical and non-technical stakeholders. Support user story development, estimates, and refinement discussions. Qualifications Required Skills and Experience Bachelor’s degree with 2-5 years of relevant UI/UX experience,or commensurate experience. Proficiency in Figma, prototyping, and design system-driven workflows. Experience conducting user research and usability testing. Strong understanding of UX design lifecycle, IA, interaction design, and content structure. Knowledge of Section 508 / WCAG accessibility compliance. Experience working in Agile environments with cross-functional teams. Familiarity with Jira, Confluence, GitHub, or similar tools. Must be a U.S. citizen or authorized to work in the U.S. Preferred Skills And Experience Experience working with the VA or other federal agencies. Familiarity with the VA.gov design system, ecosystem, and content patterns. Experience designing complex transactional workflows (benefits, eligibility, forms). Experience improving workflows within policy-driven or compliance-heavy systems. Familiarity with AI-enabled research or design tools. Clearance Required: Ability to obtain and maintain Public Trust clearance. Posted Salary Range: USD $85,000.00 - USD $95,000.00 /Yr. We are looking for a UI/UX Designer to help train and improve cutting-edge AI models. You’ll assess and enhance how AI systems understand, generate, and evaluate design work — including interfaces, layouts, visuals, and user experiences. In this role, you’ll use your design expertise to evaluate AI outputs, provide detailed feedback, and help refine the model’s sense of aesthetics, usability, and creative quality. Your insights will directly shape how the next generation of AI tools supports designers. This is a new and growing area for our company — focused on teaching AI to better understand visual and design principles. At this stage, designers should apply through our general core assessment and then complete a qualification for Web & UI/UX Design. Once approved, you’ll not only have access to general AI training projects but also be invited to contribute to design-specific projects. These projects focus on areas such as UI/UX critique, product visuals, and aesthetic evaluation (including presentations and creative deliverables). Benefits This is a full-time or part-time REMOTE position You’ll be able to choose which projects you want to work on You can work on your own schedule General AI training projects start at $25-$30+ USD/hr, while design-focused projects start at $40+ USD/hr, with bonuses for exceptional work. Responsibilities Review and critique AI-generated UI/UX designs, mockups, and visuals Evaluate the quality produced by AI models for correctness and performance Help train models to better understand aesthetic quality and user-centered design Qualifications Fluency in English (native or bilingual level) Background in UI/UX design, web design, product design, or graphic design Strong understanding of visual hierarchy, interaction design, and user flow Excellent command of grammar, style, and brand voice A current, in progress, or completed Bachelor's is preferred but not required Note: Payment is made via PayPal. We will never ask for any money from you. PayPal will handle any currency conversions from USD. Only applicants in the United States will be considered for this role. Save Report this job We are looking for a UI/UX Designer to help train and improve cutting-edge AI models. You’ll assess and enhance how AI systems understand, generate, and evaluate design work — including interfaces, layouts, visuals, and user experiences. In this role, you’ll use your design expertise to evaluate AI outputs, provide detailed feedback, and help refine the model’s sense of aesthetics, usability, and creative quality. Your insights will directly shape how the next generation of AI tools supports designers. This is a new and growing area for our company — focused on teaching AI to better understand visual and design principles. At this stage, designers should apply through our general core assessment and then complete a qualification for Web & UI/UX Design. Once approved, you’ll not only have access to general AI training projects but also be invited to contribute to design-specific projects. These projects focus on areas such as UI/UX critique, product visuals, and aesthetic evaluation (including presentations and creative deliverables). Benefits This is a full-time or part-time REMOTE position You’ll be able to choose which projects you want to work on You can work on your own schedule General AI training projects start at $25-$30+ USD/hr, while design-focused projects start at $40+ USD/hr, with bonuses for exceptional work. Responsibilities Review and critique AI-generated UI/UX designs, mockups, and visuals Evaluate the quality produced by AI models for correctness and performance Help train models to better understand aesthetic quality and user-centered design Qualifications Fluency in English (native or bilingual level) Background in UI/UX design, web design, product design, or graphic design Strong understanding of visual hierarchy, interaction design, and user flow Excellent command of grammar, style, and brand voice A current, in progress, or completed Bachelor's is preferred but not required Note: Payment is made via PayPal. We will never ask for any money from you. PayPal will handle any currency conversions from USD. Only applicants in the United States will be considered for this role. Save Report this job We’re looking for a Content Designer to join the Personalization Design team at Spotify, a multidisciplinary group building some of the world’s most loved audio experiences, including Discover Weekly, AI DJ, and Prompted Playlist. We design how listeners discover, explore, and connect with music, podcasts, and audiobooks, shaping experiences that feel personal, playful, and deeply intuitive at global scale. This role sits at the intersection of language, systems, and intelligence. You’ll help define how users express intent, understand recommendations, and collaborate with Spotify through words—moving discovery from something that happens to listeners into something they actively shape. Through thoughtful content design, you’ll give form, clarity, and personality to agentic, LLM-powered experiences. In this role, you’ll also focus on designing clear, human, and expressive content across AI-driven features, with an emphasis on prompts, conversational flows, feedback, and system language that help users steer recommendations with confidence. This is a mid-level role for someone who’s confident designing product copy and content systems, excited by ambiguity and emerging technology, and motivated by the challenge of giving Spotify’s agentic experiences a voice that feels intuitive, trustworthy, and unmistakably Spotify. What You'll Do Lead content strategy for agentic products. Define and own how Spotify communicates through LLMs by setting voice, personality, and tone standards. Build content frameworks used by composition and engineering. Design, author, and evaluate prompts and system instructions for generative features. Build reusable prompt templates, experiments, and guardrails with product, engineering, and safety teams. Write and iterate on high-quality, in-product language (microcopy, help text, error states, onboarding, notifications, tooltips, naming) that is accessible, inclusive, and measurable. Partner with product managers, designers, researchers, and engineers to translate user and business needs into content requirements; participate in discovery, design critiques, and localization planning. Partner with engineers to design and run human-in-the-loop evaluations. You’ll define what "good" looks like for AI-generated text and use those insights to tune model performance. Who You Are You’re an experienced content designer and UX writer, with a portfolio that shows you can solve complex problems through language. You have a background in conversation design and character development, and bringing brands to life through applied voice and tone guidelines. You have hands-on experience working with LLMs, prompt design, and evaluation. You understand the difference between a zero-shot and few-shot prompt, and you know how to iterate on instructions to get a specific tonal output and avoid hallucinations. You can navigate ambiguity, collaborate across teams and subject areas, and tackle complex flows that span states, surfaces, or systems. Direct message the job poster from Riviera Jana Goyette Jana Goyette People Operations Lead at Santa Barbara Management & Riviera What We're Building Riviera is the command center for family wealth. Riviera gives families operational control over their entire financial world: every entity, account, and investment connected, with the terms, people, and context inside each one. Where the industry has historically reported on wealth, Riviera enables families to command it. The family offices and advisory firms managing the world's most successful families' wealth are analog businesses. Trillions of dollars are running on spreadsheets, filing cabinets, and disconnected point solutions. Institutional inertia and technological backwardation are dressed up as bespoke, white-glove service, applied to financial lives as complex as those of multi-billion dollar companies. The industry's answer has been more of the same: more people, more spreadsheets, more manual reconciliation, and more legacy software producing work out of date the moment it is created. Clients tolerate this because there is no alternative. Riviera is what comes next: an AI-native system of action that puts families in command. How We Build We are building Riviera the modern way. No large engineering teams flanked by separate product, design, and QA functions. We hire entrepreneurial operators who own products end-to-end: spend time with users, design, then build and ship. Design works closely with engineering and product, but every member of the team is expected to operate full-stack. We build for principals first. Our users are highly sophisticated, mostly non-technical, and in some cases not software-savvy at all. The product has to be simple enough for them to get their arms around their wealth on their own. Underneath, it has to capture the full complexity of how their financial lives actually work. That's the design problem. The Role As Riviera's Founding Designer, you own the experience of the product. The product is live, the clients are real, and the design problem is significant. What You'll Do: Build for principals first. Make the platform simple enough for non-technical users to operate confidently, with the depth they need available when they look for it. This is the central design challenge. Live with our users. Direct, daily contact with families, advisors, and operating teams. Not research-by-proxy. The quality of the product follows the quality of what you observe. Ship the work. You design and you build. You write production code into the application alongside engineering and own a meaningful portion of the front end. Build the design system. Establish the components and patterns that scale across the platform and the team to come. Treat the system as a product. Set the bar. Every decision you make defines what good looks like for everyone who joins after you. Who You Are You have shipped product design that real users depend on. Not marketing pages or portfolio work, but information-dense daily-use software. You've owned design end-to-end as a senior or sole designer before. You are AI-native in a way you can demonstrate. How you research, design, prototype, and ship today looks materially different from two years ago. You run user research as an ongoing practice, not a sprint. Daily contact with users is how you work, not a special event. You have strong opinions about software, the humility to test them against what users actually do, and the judgment to know when to hold the line and when to ship. Experience designing for fintech, wealth management, or other data-rich regulated categories is a plus. What We Offer Founding Designer status. Direct access to the founding team and significant influence over product direction. Competitive compensation and benefits. We work together in person four days a week in our Chicago HQ. POSH Policy Swish POSH: Ensuring Safety, Respect & Dignity for All At Swish, we believe that every person deserves to work in an environment where they feel respected, valued and safe. A workplace should never be a place of fear or discomfort. For us, the Prevention of Sexual Harassment (POSH) policy is not just a document that fulfills compliance requirements, it is our commitment to building a culture of dignity, inclusion and fairness. We want every employee, regardless of their role or seniority, to know that they are protected and supported. Respect, safety and inclusion are not optional at Swish, they are the foundation of how we work and grow together. Policy Details Our POSH policy is designed to cover everyone associated with the company including full-time employees, part-time team members, contract workers, interns, freelancers and even visitors who come into our workplace. No matter where you stand in the organization, these protections apply to you equally. We strictly prohibit any form of harassment. This includes verbal remarks, physical advances, inappropriate jokes or gestures, unwanted digital communication or requests for personal favours. In short, any behaviour that compromises someone’s dignity, comfort or safety has no place at Swish. If you ever experience or witness such behaviour, you have the right and the responsibility to report it. All reports are handled with confidentiality and sensitivity. We investigate concerns in a fair and timely manner, always with respect for privacy. Most importantly, Swish has a strict policy against retaliation: raising your voice will never put you at risk. What we stand for Respect: We honour each person’s boundaries, perspectives and individuality. Safety: Your physical, emotional and mental well-being is a priority at work and beyond. Inclusivity: We embrace diversity in all its forms and ensure that every voice, background and role is valued. Empowerment: We encourage you to speak up, share concerns and trust that you will be supported and protected. Conclusion Swish is committed to being a people-first company where every employee can thrive without fear of harassment or discrimination. If at any time you feel uncomfortable, mistreated or unsure about a situation, we urge you to reach out. We will listen, we will act and we will stand with you. Together, we can continue to build a workplace that truly reflects our values, safe, inclusive, respectful and empowering for all. For concerns or to report an incident, you can contact us confidentially at posh@justswish.in

Transactions Involving Third Parties: We make available to you services, software, and content provided by third parties for use on or through AWS Offerings. For example, you can order services, software, and content from sellers using the AWS Marketplace and we provide those sellers information to facilitate your subscription, purchases, or support. Third-Party Service Providers: We employ other companies and individuals to perform functions on our behalf.
